root_cause.text: The authencesn driver fails to validate that the AAD length (assoclen) is at least 8 bytes before using it to derive offsets, allowing out-of-bounds scatterlist access that leads to a NULL pointer dereference.

The commit description states: "When assoclen is shorter than the minimum expected length, crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt() can advance past the end of the destination scatterlist and trigger a NULL pointer dereference in scatterwalk_map_and_copy()".
